clue.text: Means of securing important raw material

definitions.meaning: a bent wire fastener pushed through paper or into wood
a principal commodity of a trade or region, such as a nation's main crop

explanation.surface: A dry note about securing supplies of a key raw material.
explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both the bent wire fastener and a principal commodity, as in a country's staple product.

indicators.note: breaking suggests the inner part is smashed and set back the other way round
heart limits the change to the two central letters of the novice word

parts.note: a tiro (or tyro) is a beginner or novice

explanation.surface: A trio of people breaks the heart of an inexperienced newcomer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'breaking' and 'heart' together swap the middle pair IR of TIRO round to RI.
explanation.definitionFit: A trio is a group of three, the same as a threesome.

clue.text: Sticky situation leads to increased tension

parts.note: a post is a job or position, a situation

indicators.note: leads to means the opening letters of the next two words are taken

explanation.surface: A sticky situation is one where tension mounts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sticky' looks like part of the phrase 'sticky situation'; it is the definition on its own.
explanation.definitionFit: A Post-it is a small adhesive note, so a sticky in casual office speech.

clue.text: Intractable objections raised and brought forth

indicators.note: raised in a down clue means the word is read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: buts are objections, as in 'no ifs or buts'
born means brought forth into the world

explanation.surface: Someone intractable keeps raising objections and producing them.
explanation.definitionFit: Stubborn and intractable both describe someone who will not be moved or managed.

clue.text: Named one treated like a god bored by religious work

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: bored by means the godly word has the religious work drilled into it

parts.note: deified means made into or treated as a god
NT, the New Testament, is a religious work

explanation.surface: A person named is treated like a deity, yet bored by a religious text.
explanation.definitionFit: To identify someone is to say who they are, so named and identified are synonyms.

clue.text: Predicts sound of what cuckoo clock has

indicators.note: sound of says the word is identified by how it is spoken rather than spelt

parts.note: the words 'cuckoo clock' contain four letter Cs

explanation.surface: Someone forecasts the noise a cuckoo clock makes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'what cuckoo clock has' is not a bird or chime but its spelling: four Cs, said as 'four sees'.
explanation.definitionFit: To foresee is to see in advance, which is to predict.

indicators.note: Half-cut says one half of the word is cut away, here the front half

parts.note: senators are politicians in an upper house

explanation.surface: Drunken politicians in positions of power.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Half-cut' looks like slang for tipsy; it removes SENA from SENATORS. TORIES is the tempting first thought but does not halve neatly.
explanation.definitionFit: A tor is a rocky hill or peak, especially on Dartmoor, so tors are elevated spots.

clue.text: Noted movie shot in urban location

indicators.note: shot means wrecked or broken up, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A well-known film was filmed in a city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shot' reads as filming but is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Montevideo is the capital city of Uruguay, so it is an example of an urban location.

indicators.note: returning means the selected letters run back the other way
some means just a portion of the word deliveries is used

explanation.surface: A base sends back some of the deliveries it receives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'some' picks ELIV from inside 'deliveries' and 'returning' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: Base in the sense of morally low or contemptible is a synonym of vile.

definitions.meaning: fruit in the sense of a result or outcome, the fruit of one's labour
in arithmetic a square is the result of multiplying a number by itself

explanation.surface: A piece of fruit that might be square-shaped.
explanation.definitionFit: A result is the fruit of effort, and multiplying a number by itself gives a product that is its square.

clue.text: Assumes Republican power divides America repeatedly

indicators.note: repeatedly means the America abbreviation is used a second time, so it appears twice in a row

parts.note: US is short for the United States of America

indicators.note: divides means the political pair splits the doubled country letters

parts.note: P is the symbol for power in physics

explanation.surface: Republican power-grabbing keeps splitting the nation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'repeatedly' doubles US to USUS, and 'divides' places RP inside the second US.
explanation.definitionFit: To usurp is to take over power wrongfully, which is to assume it.

clue.text: Prerequisite for walking evident in non-verbal ancestors

indicators.note: evident in says the answer can be seen sitting inside the following words

explanation.surface: Our pre-language ancestors showed what was needed for upright walking.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across 'non-verBAL ANCEstors'.
explanation.definitionFit: Staying upright on two legs needs a steady equilibrium, so balance is a precondition of walking.

clue.text: Discharge university dons beginning to expect time off

indicators.note: beginning to means just the opening letter of the next word
dons means wears or puts on, so one piece takes the other inside it

parts.note: a vacation is time off work or study

explanation.surface: University lecturers are dismissed, and start expecting a long break.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dons' looks like academics but is the instruction to set U inside VACATION.
explanation.definitionFit: Evacuation is the emptying or expelling of something, a sense shared with discharge.

clue.text: What brings a lump to men's throats?

definitions.text: What brings a lump to men's throats?

parts.words: What brings a lump to men's throats?
parts.note: plays on the emotional phrase 'a lump in the throat' while literally describing the bulge of cartilage in the neck

explanation.surface: A question about what makes men emotional.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests tearful feeling; the answer is the physical bump of the larynx.
explanation.definitionFit: The thyroid cartilage forms a visible protrusion in the neck, more prominent in men.

definitions.meaning: lineage or ancestry, as in descended from a noble house
a trade or occupation, as in asking someone what they do for a living

explanation.surface: A family firm.
explanation.definitionFit: Line means both ancestry or lineage and a person's occupation or trade.

clue.text: False promises disheartened party supporting European Union

indicators.note: supporting in a down clue puts this piece below the one it holds up
disheartened means the word loses its heart, leaving only its outside letters

parts.note: a do is a party

explanation.surface: Insincere pledges dismay a party that backs the EU.
explanation.definitionFit: Pseudo means sham or not genuine, so it means false.

indicators.note: eats means the man word swallows the other piece

parts.note: chap is an informal word for a man

explanation.surface: A husband eating his midday meal with loud chewing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'eats' looks like part of the meal scene but tells CHAP to take M inside.
explanation.definitionFit: To champ is to chew or munch noisily, so it can mean eating a meal loudly.

clue.text: PC still to admit superior officer's correct to go to press?

parts.note: a PC (police constable) is a cop

indicators.note: to admit means to let in, so one piece enters another

parts.note: yet can mean still, as in 'yet more'
DI, a detective inspector, outranks a constable

explanation.surface: A constable must still let his boss correct the statement before it goes to the papers.
explanation.definitionFit: Copy-editing is checking and correcting text before publication.

parts.note: I is the symbol for electric current
on means working, as a machine that is switched on

explanation.surface: A question about what running electricity depends on.
explanation.walkthrough: As a whole, electric current flowing through a solution is carried by charged particles.
explanation.definitionFit: An ion is a charged atom or molecule, the carrier of current in electrolysis.

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered widely, so these letters are spread and rearranged

explanation.surface: A complaint that our foolish programme is misleading viewers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' reads as transmission but is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Something illusory gives a false impression, which is deceptive or misleading.

parts.note: S is the genealogical abbreviation for succeeded
in and hip both mean fashionable

explanation.surface: Someone made it in mere seconds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' looks like a link word but means fashionable.
explanation.definitionFit: Craft is a word for boats or vessels, so ships are craft.

definitions.meaning: an amorous approach, as when someone makes a move on another
a defile is a narrow route through mountains
to succeed in an exam, and so qualify

explanation.surface: Unwanted sexual approaches sully a young graduate.
explanation.walkthrough: A triple definition. 'defile' looks like a verb meaning sully; it is the noun, a narrow gorge. The first definition is plural in the clue, a loose fit for the singular word.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means an amorous advance, a narrow route through mountains, and to succeed in an exam.

parts.note: blue means sad or miserable
a murder is the collective noun for a group of crows

explanation.surface: Sad birds are making a terrible racket.
explanation.walkthrough: MURDER is the collective noun for crows.
explanation.definitionFit: To scream blue murder is to make a loud, alarmed outcry, so the phrase means a dreadful din.

indicators.note: receives means the first pieces take another one in

parts.note: a fete is a festive party or outdoor celebration
F is the pencil-grading abbreviation for fine

explanation.surface: A decadent English party gets a penalty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fine' reads as a penalty, but it is F.
explanation.definitionFit: Effete means weak and over-refined through self-indulgence, close to decadent.

indicators.note: with external says the support word wraps round the outside of the other

parts.note: a rest is a support, as for a snooker cue or an arm
is in the sense of exists or still is

explanation.surface: A fight goes on with backing from outside.
explanation.definitionFit: To resist is to fight against something, so it means to struggle against it.

indicators.note: involves means the rearranged letters wrap round the next piece
possibly signals that these letters might be arranged in another way

explanation.surface: A sexual scandal may embroil the president.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' rearranges the word sex to EXS before the president goes in.
explanation.definitionFit: Express means stated clearly and directly, the same as explicit.

indicators.note: Start to means only the opening letter of the next word

parts.note: cattle are lowers, things that low or moo

explanation.surface: A farmer begins fattening livestock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stocks' looks like livestock but is the garden plant; 'cattle' becomes LOWERS, beasts that low.
explanation.definitionFit: Stocks are scented garden plants, so they are examples of flowers, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Report people voting for socialist order

indicators.note: Report means the word is as heard, giving a word that sounds the same

parts.note: the ayes are those voting in favour in Parliament
left describes socialist politics

explanation.surface: News of left-wing supporters voting for a socialist programme.
explanation.walkthrough: 'order' looks like a political arrangement but is a parade-ground command.
explanation.definitionFit: Eyes left is a drill command telling soldiers to turn their heads, so a military order.

parts.note: poorly means unwell, ill
read as re-present, to present again, it means to iterate or repeat

explanation.surface: An instruction to depict an unlearned person badly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'represent' must be split as re-present, giving ITERATE.
explanation.definitionFit: An illiterate is a person who cannot read, an uneducated figure.

indicators.note: excludes means the child word is shut out of the schooling word

parts.note: lessons are schooling
a son is a child

explanation.surface: Poor schools leave a child out.
explanation.definitionFit: Less can mean lower in rank or importance, as in 'no less a person', so inferior.
